intent: Complete the original approved EvoPilot v5 scheme through Runtime 5.0.1 completion recovery: close every Runtime, project, Harness-binding, Lifecycle, recovery, contract, documentation, reference, acceptance-integrity, and real E2E gap with criterion-specific executable evidence, TRACE01-TRACE06, an exact installed Runtime and Expert Candidate pair, and NO_REGRESSION, while leaving both independently evolving legacy Codex Suites active and untouched until a separately authorized post-release Cutover.
objective: Deliver an immutable Runtime 5.0.1 completion successor in which every original v5 requirement and explicit user correction is implemented, independently validated, traceable to concrete evidence and terminal journeys, and impossible to report complete unless total equals passed, all incomplete evidence classes are zero, the exact installed Candidate pair is verified, and NO_REGRESSION passes.

Exact authorization to update only the EvoPilot Roadmap, Roadmap Gate, and tests and to draft and preflight Runtime Target revision 2; not product implementation, Suite mutation, or release authority.
Current human Roadmap and product narrative.
Published v4 acceptance baseline to inherit and retest; not authority for v5 implementation.
Independent published Harness producer and cross-project contract evidence only; no authorization to modify it.
Enterprise-internal reference declaration and journey evidence only.
Documentation structure and information-architecture reference only; no copied branding, text, general-Agent scope, or product authority.

include: Create a digest-bound original-scheme inventory and requirement-to-successor-criterion-to-deliverable-to-independent-validator-to-evidence-to-terminal-E2E traceability matrix covering accepted v5 Roadmap revisions, Runtime v5.0.0 Target revision 2, Expert v1.0.0 Target revision 2, every explicit user correction, and every audited gap.

Implement an executable completion aggregator that reports total, passed, failed, pending, stale, generic, and unmapped counts; it must reject silent exclusions, generic aggregate evidence, bulk PASS projection, warnings as PASS, or human declarations substituted for required machine evidence.

Make HarnessExecutionBinding a mandatory executed invariant across Lifecycle, Goal, Target, Loop start, resume, retry, and every iteration, with real immutable Registry, Catalog, Profile, Bundle, Component, Lifecycle, Policy, Provider, Environment, Host, Runtime, authority, and evidence digest revalidation rather than type-only or helper-only presence.

Wire the bounded Recovery Controller and governed Automation Registry into actual pipeline failure classification, repair, receipt reconciliation, retry, rollback, restart, resume, Host transfer, rule suspension, and exact one-time automation-rule activation.

Complete EvolutionProjectDefinition discovery, canonicalization, schema validation, schema-driven dialogue, semantic diff, compatibility impact, immutable active-run binding, migration, rollback, SecretRef, OpenAPI, CLI, API, MCP, CI, and event contracts without repository-named Engine branches.

Close README, installation, concepts, DDD architecture, Harness binding, Lifecycle, recovery, Expert and Host integration, reference declarations, tutorials, migration, security, operations, acceptance, and release documentation against executable commands and exact installed-version behavior.

Implement criterion-specific validators and evidence collectors for every FUNC01-FUNC21, CAP01-CAP16, DOC01-DOC13, V4 inherited criterion, V5 predecessor criterion, E2E01-E2E13, TRACE01-TRACE06, impact closure, and NO_REGRESSION.

Build one exact private Runtime 5.0.1 Candidate and one compatible exact Expert 1.0.1 Candidate before counted E2E, install both outside source checkout, run all terminal journeys including real Codex, designated-human WorkBuddy, independent Host, headless, restart/resume, soak, and public-surface simulations, and promote accepted bytes without rebuild only under later separate release authorizations.
Add the replacement architecture ADR and executable guards for the v5 DDD boundaries, Harness-guided invariant, independent Expert, and Host versus Runtime separation.
Implement EvolutionProjectDefinition and project-owned declarative resources for source, ecosystem, delivery, policy, secrets by reference, environment, Host, Runtime, and evidence discovery.

Implement Published Harness Consumption and Immutable Execution Binding as a first-class bounded context over Registry, Catalog, HarnessProfile, immutable HarnessBundle closure, eligibility, deterministic ranking, ambiguity, and abstention.
Make an exact eligible published immutable HarnessBundle mandatory for every Goal Target Loop and revalidate all relevant bindings before start, resume, retry, and every Loop iteration.

Compose Harness obligations with open Lifecycle orchestration monotonically: intersect permissions, union obligations, report conflicts deterministically, and never weaken required Harness evidence, validators, constraints, boundaries, or capabilities.
Implement project-neutral Lifecycle modules, schema-driven conversational and headless parameters, immutable input provenance, and explicit human decisions only at genuine authority boundaries.

Implement bounded deterministic Recovery Controller behavior and a governed Automation Registry whose learned rules require one exact human decision before activation and remain inspectable, revocable, scoped, versioned, and auditable.
Define and implement a stable Runtime-owned Human Interaction Protocol used equivalently by independent Expert, MCP, CLI, API, and CI clients without transferring product truth or authority.
Support Codex as both Agent Host and execution Runtime, retain WorkBuddy and an independent conformant Host, and keep model, Host, and execution-provider concerns separate.
Provide declarative DataRig, EvoPilot, evopilot-harness, and unknown-project reference cases without repository-named Engine branches.

Keep the real EvoPilot Codex Suite and DataRig Codex Suite active, independently owned, and independently evolving before v5 release; bind late exact snapshots for read-only comparison, stale affected evidence on snapshot drift, and prove zero invocation and no hidden fallback only in isolated Candidate environments where both Suites are absent.
Synchronize README, concepts, DDD architecture, Harness binding, Lifecycle, recovery, Expert/Host integration, tutorials, migration, security, operations, acceptance, and release documentation.

Prepare declarative migration inventory and post-release Cutover readiness evidence without switching defaults or mutating either installed Suite; actual disablement, archival, uninstall, or retirement belongs to the separate evopilot-post-v5.0.0-legacy-suite-cutover milestone.
Build exact private Runtime Candidates before counted E2E, install outside source checkout, bind acceptance to exact bytes, and promote without rebuild only after separate Release authorization.
exclude: Any claim that public Runtime 5.0.0, Expert 1.0.0, their aggregate acceptance record, or publication alone proves the original v5 scheme complete.
Any silent exclusion, bulk PASS projection, warning-as-pass, generic aggregate evidence, source-checkout substitution, or human declaration substituted for required machine evidence.
Harness asset reasoning, authoring, mutation, review, approval, evaluation, publication, Catalog mutation, or Registry mutation in EvoPilot.
Any modification to evopilot-harness product, Roadmap, Target, source, package, or published assets.
Making Harness optional, allowing Lifecycle to weaken Harness, or allowing Expert conversation to choose, fabricate, mutate, approve, or publish Harness assets.
Embedding a general-purpose coding Agent, model loop, tool loop, or model-training system inside EvoPilot.
Project-specific Engine branches or hidden fallback to either legacy Codex Suite.
Raw secret capture in declarations, conversation, evidence, logs, or durable Runtime state.
Inferring source, database, production, credential, acceptance, publication, or Release authority from Harness, Lifecycle, Expert, Host, parameter entry, test success, or generic conversation.
Evolution Expert package implementation or publication, except the Runtime-owned protocol and compatibility surfaces explicitly required by this Target.

Any real EvoPilot Codex Suite or DataRig Codex Suite disablement, move, deletion, uninstall, archive, retirement, restriction of independent evolution, or default switch before public Runtime 5.0.1 and Expert 1.0.1 complete the original scheme and pass fresh installation verification.
Any post-release legacy Suite Cutover action without its own Evolution Target and separate explicit human authorization.

Commit, push, Candidate build, acceptance execution, Codex or WorkBuddy operation, npm/GHCR publication, GitHub Release, deployment, production access, or database access under this unapproved completion-recovery draft.

designDecisions.coreInvariant: Every Goal Target Loop requires one exact eligible published immutable HarnessBundle and one resolved open Lifecycle.
designDecisions.domainModel: Project declaration, Harness consumption and binding, Lifecycle execution, recovery, interaction, Host, Runtime, acceptance, and release are explicit bounded contexts.
designDecisions.compositionRule: Harness defines mandatory professional obligations; Lifecycle orchestrates and may strengthen but never weaken them.
designDecisions.authorityRule: Harness, Lifecycle, Expert, Host, and Runtime capability do not grant external authority.
designDecisions.expertBoundary: Evolution Expert is independently versioned and stateless with respect to Runtime truth; the Runtime remains complete headlessly.
designDecisions.legacyTransition: The real EvoPilot and DataRig Codex Suites remain installed, active, independent, and untouched. Cutover is outside this Target and requires public completion successors, verified installation, a separate Cutover Target, and separate human authorization.
designDecisions.releaseTopology: Runtime and Expert Candidates, acceptance, authorization, releases, upgrades, and rollbacks are independent.
designDecisions.legacySnapshotDrift: A Suite snapshot binds source identity, version, tree digest, Skill and rule inventory, capturedAt, and corpus digest; drift makes only affected parity evidence STALE and requires a fresh snapshot plus selective rerun.
designDecisions.legacyCutoverReleaseRelationship: Post-release Cutover is operational migration work and is not a v5 Release blocker.
designDecisions.completionInvariant: V5_ORIGINAL_SCHEME_100_PERCENT_CLOSURE: total equals passed; failed, pending, stale, generic, and unmapped are zero; exact installed Candidate pair verified; NO_REGRESSION passed.
designDecisions.evidenceDisposition: Runtime 5.0.0 and Expert 1.0.0 evidence is historical process evidence only; successor acceptance must be criterion-specific and freshly bound.

realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: isolated install logs, help transcript, tutorial receipts, zero external effects, and cross-host semantic comparison

realCaseCoverage.scenario: An unknown project is declared and completes its first Harness-guided governed Goal.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: fresh project declaration, match trace, immutable binding, Goal Target Loop evidence, and zero Engine diff

realCaseCoverage.scenario: A project definition is adjusted, drift is detected selectively, and the definition is rolled back without evidence loss.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: before/after digests, impacted decision set, rollback receipts, and preserved evidence graph

realCaseCoverage.scenario: DataRig completes the enterprise-internal reference lifecycle in an isolated Candidate environment where the DataRig Codex Suite is absent, without legacy Suite invocation or embedded project constants, while its real installed independently evolving Suite remains untouched.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: late exact DataRig Suite snapshot, installed Candidate journey, isolated Suite-absence proof, declaration provenance, recovery trace, authority boundary evidence, no-project-branch scan, and real-installed-Suite non-mutation evidence

realCaseCoverage.scenario: EvoPilot performs GitHub open-source self-evolution from exact Goal through RC, isolated acceptance, separate release authorization, public release, and terminal verification.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: exact Candidate handoff, acceptance aggregate, authorization digests, no-rebuild promotion, GitHub/npm/GHCR/installer/deployment verification

realCaseCoverage.scenario: evopilot-harness producer reference reaches release-ready state while EvoPilot and Expert remain read-only Harness consumers.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: exact published Bundle binding, filesystem sentinels, no producer mutation, and stopped-before-publication evidence

realCaseCoverage.scenario: A deterministic failure recovers, an unknown class produces one Automation Registry proposal, one human decision activates it, then restart, resume, and Host transfer complete automatically.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Exact RC bytes are installed in isolation, acceptance closes, a separate Release authorization is recorded, bytes promote without rebuild, and public surfaces verify.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: RC digests, isolation proof, 100% acceptance aggregate, release authorization, byte identity, signatures, install and public verification

realCaseCoverage.scenario: EvoPilot and DataRig run read-only shadow comparisons against late-bound exact Suite snapshots and then complete success, failure, resume, upgrade, and rollback with both legacy Codex Suites absent from isolated Candidate environments, proving zero invocation and no hidden fallback without disabling, moving, deleting, uninstalling, or archiving the real installed Suites.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: exact snapshot manifests and corpus digests, snapshot-drift stale/selective-rerun evidence, isolated Suite-absence proof, legacySuiteInvocationCount zero, path and process sentinels, representative journeys, and real-installed-Suite non-mutation evidence

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Evolution Expert upgrades and rolls back independently while Runtime bytes and version remain unchanged.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: exact Runtime digest before/after, Expert Candidate/version changes, protocol compatibility, upgrade and rollback conformance

realCaseCoverage.scenario: A new third-party Host Adapter qualifies against common Expert and Runtime protocols with zero Engine source modification.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: generated adapter, Core digest, conformance report, Host capability binding, and Engine source diff

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Evolution Expert is absent and then deliberately incompatible while headless CLI, API, and CI complete the same governed Runtime journey.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: missing/incompatible diagnostics plus complete headless results with equivalent authoritative object digests

realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: match and abstention portfolio, complete HarnessExecutionBinding, composition report, per-iteration drift checks, replay, and cross-client equivalence
